claims.text: The per-word reward is tuned using a perceptron-like method, which allows for quick adjustments post-training.
The optimal value of the word reward is sensitive to task, beam size, and dataset, necessitating specific tuning for each model.
Tuning the word reward generally leads to improvements in performance metrics like METEOR and BLEU scores across different language pairs.
